description:
The first time you constricted yourself was when you were a child

You were bouncing with energy, loving life, and some important figure ( mother, father, older sibling) 

Told you to STOP

all of the sudden, you think “ outgoing good feelings are bad, I must hold myself back” 

And the first block was formed.

Many more stacked from there

But underneath it all is an ABUNDANCE of energy waiting to reclaimed

You just have to let go

It’s not your fault these things happened

But it is your responsibility to choose how you will LIVE

It’s is YOUR life

You can keep the blocks in your energy

Or remove them and be free

you choose.
.
.
.
.

transcript: This will be a story about the first time you most likely lost your charismatic state. You were one, two years old. You were running around, beaming with positive energy, causing a ruckus. And some important figure in your life, like a parent, your mother, your father, or an older sibling, looked at you and said, hey, stop that, right? With an aggressive tone, they're like, stop that. They're getting tired of it, right? They have their own issues they're dealing with. But in your vulnerable young state, you took that as this positive energy that I'm just expressing, that it's just coming through me is bad. It's dangerous. If I am too outgoing, if I am too charismatic, if I'm too much like myself and expressive, the people that I love might abandon me. So then you squeeze it off. The energy gets squeezed off and that gets built into your system and now years later all grown up an adult you still have that in you so you still are suppressing that energy because of what happened when you were young and that's when you first lost your charisma but the truth is the energy is still under the surface. You can let that go. You just have to move within and really feel into that energy because what's stored in there is this dangerous feeling, this feeling of being ostracized or you're going to get cut off from the group or people aren't going to love you. And as you encounter that and lovingly feel into it, you can let it go.
